contact.name: François Morissette
contact.evidence_quote: My coaching draws from Flow Coaching — a strength-based approach rooted in positive psychology — as well as my 20+ years as a Public Service executive. As an Associate Certified Coach (ACC), I’m guided by the International Coaching Federation and its Code of ethics. ... “Making the jump from a superstar analyst to management can be very tough, because leading a team requires different skills. Leadership coaching from Francois Morissette helped me to be deliberate in establishing my leadership style, navigate the challenges of being a new manager and learn the GC core leadership competencies.” – 2025

contacts.rung: Principal / director (no Erasmus contact found). François Morissette is the founder and executive coach of FC Morissette Consulting, providing leadership training and coaching services.

As an Associate with the Institute on Governance, I lead peer coaching training as part of its Executive Leadership Programs.
I’m a PSPC ProServices supplier and coach with the Public Service Commission’s Executive Counselling Services. I volunteer as a Board member of the Glebe Neighbourhood Activities Group (GNAG).
